name: hugo-mod-graphviz-vendored
description: Declares the third-party libraries this module vendors under assets/libs/. Never installed at build time or at runtime: it exists so Dependabot tracks their versions and GitHub raises security alerts on the code we actually ship. See ../VENDORED.md.

viz.js.note: jsDelivr's pass-through of lib/viz-standalone.js: the file is already minified, so the CDN only prepends a banner. Re-fetching that URL reproduces the checksum below; fetching lib/viz-standalone.js directly does not.
